name: Sky Industries Limited
about: Sky Industries Limited manufactures, markets, and sells narrow woven fabrics in India. The company offers hook and loop; pressure sensitive adhesives, such as rubber based self-adhesive hook and loop, regular rubber based self adhesive hook and loop, adhesive coins, adhesive piece cuts, adhesive mated piece cuts, and adhesive score cuts; speciality products, including moulded and injection hook, knit loop and velour, back to back tapes, elasticated loop tapes, bobbin tapes, and auto loop; other products, comprising webbings, neoprene, insect screen, speciality elastics, velvet tapes, and straps; solution base products, such as sleeves, tile grip, headgear, others, customized straps, and aplix products. It serves footwear, orthopaedic, defense, medical equipments, sports, ppe, automotive, packaging, apparels, infant wear, cable networking, FIBC, aviation, home furnishing, luggage, abrasives, stationery, display, warehousing, spinning mills, construction, and equestrian industries. It also exports its products to the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Turkey, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and others. The company was formerly known as Fine Velvets and Plastofabs Private Limited. Sky Industries Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.
